paras: Bauer's leaf-toed gecko (Dixonius aaronbaueri) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Vietnam.
The specific name, aaronbaueri, is in honor of American herpetologist Aaron M. Bauer.
D. aaronbaueri is found in southern Vietnam, in Binh Thuan Province and Ninh Thuan Province.
The preferred natural habitats of D. aaronbaueri are forest and sand dunes, at altitudes from sea level to 5 m (16 ft), but it has also been found in plantations.
D. aaronbaueri may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of almost 4 cm (1.6 in).
The mode of reproduction of D. aaronbaueri has not been ascertained.
